Length.Name: ZZYZX
Length.Description: "Height H: top of the handrail above the foot"

Length.Name: postW
Length.Description: "Post size along x (rectangle width / diameter / flat bar thickness)"

Length.Name: postD
Length.Description: "Post size along y (rectangle depth / flat bar width; round: unused)"

Integer.Name: iPostMode
Integer.Description: "Post layout: 0 by count, 1 by maximum spacing"

Integer.Name: nPost
Integer.Description: "Number of post positions incl. both ends (iPostMode = 0)"

Length.Name: pInset
Length.Description: "End post axis from the segment end"

Integer.Name: iMount
Integer.Description: "Anchoring: 0 on the slab (top), 1 side / fascia mounted"

Length.Name: sideGap
Length.Description: "Side mounting: gap slab edge face (y = 0) - post face"

Length.Name: mountDrop
Length.Description: "Side mounting: post reaches below the foot by"

Integer.Name: iInfill
Integer.Description: "Infill: 0 none, 1 horizontal bars, 2 vertical balusters, 3 glass, 4 panel"

Length.Name: topGap
Length.Description: "Glass / panel: clear gap below the handrail"

Length.Name: infGap
Length.Description: "Glass / panel: clear gap to the post faces"

Length.Name: infOffs
Length.Description: "Glass / panel: offset of the infill plane from the post axis (y)"

Integer.Name: iBarDist
Integer.Description: "Horizontal bars: 0 uniform, 1 from the list barZList"

String.Name: barZList
String.Description: "Horizontal bars: axis heights above the foot, separated by ;"

Integer.Name: iPanType
Integer.Description: "Panel: 0 solid sheet, 1 perforated sheet (perforation = surface, not modelled)"

Symbol.Script_1D:
! FS_Railing 1.0 - master script: layout shared by the 2D and 3D scripts EPS = 0.00001 H = ZZYZX
! post section and the y of the railing axis IF iPostProf = 1 THEN secX = postW secY = postW ELSE secX = postW secY = postD ENDIF IF iMount = 1 THEN yc = sideGap + secY / 2 zPost0 = -mountDrop ELSE yc = 0 zPost0 = 0 ENDIF
! handrail zRailBot = H zPostTop = H IF bRail THEN IF iRailProf = 0 THEN zRailBot = H - railW zPostTop = H - railW / 2 ELSE zRailBot = H - railH zPostTop = H - railH ENDIF ENDIF
! post positions (virtual ones too: bPostStart / bPostEnd only decide whether the post body is drawn) x0 = pInset x1 = A - pInset span = x1 - x0 IF span < EPS THEN span = EPS IF iPostMode = 0 THEN nBays = MAX(1, nPost - 1) ELSE nBays = MAX(1, CEIL(span / MAX(postSp, 0.01) - EPS)) ENDIF IF nBays > 500 THEN nBays = 500 bay = span / nBays DIM px[] FOR i = 0 TO nBays px[i + 1] = x0 + i * bay NEXT i
! horizontal bars: axis heights DIM bz[] nB = 0 IF iInfill = 1 THEN IF iBarDist = 0 THEN nB = MAX(1, nBars) g = (zRailBot - botGap - nB * barD) / nB FOR i = 1 TO nB bz[i] = botGap + barD / 2 + (i - 1) * (barD + g) NEXT i ELSE s = barZList WHILE STRLEN(s) > 0 AND nB < 100 DO k = STRSTR(s, ";") IF k > 0 THEN tok = STRSUB(s, 1, k - 1) s = STRSUB(s, k + 1, STRLEN(s) - k) ELSE tok = s s = "" ENDIF nr = SPLIT(tok, "%n", v) IF nr > 0 THEN nB = nB + 1 bz[nB] = v ENDIF ENDWHILE ENDIF ENDIF
! glass / panel / balusters: vertical extent zInf0 = botGap zInf1 = zRailBot - topGap
Symbol.Script_2D: HOTSPOT2 0, yc HOTSPOT2 A, yc PROJECT2 3, 270, 2
Symbol.Script_3D:
RESOL 16 HOTSPOT 0, yc, 0 HOTSPOT A, yc, 0 HOTSPOT 0, yc, H HOTSPOT A, yc, H
! posts IF matPost > 0 THEN MATERIAL matPost ELSE MATERIAL SYMB_MAT ENDIF FOR i = 0 TO nBays bDraw = 1 IF i = 0 AND NOT(bPostStart) THEN bDraw = 0 IF i = nBays AND NOT(bPostEnd) THEN bDraw = 0 IF bDraw THEN IF iPostProf = 1 THEN ADD px[i + 1], yc, zPost0 CYLIND zPostTop - zPost0, postW / 2 DEL 1 ELSE ADD px[i + 1] - secX / 2, yc - secY / 2, zPost0 BLOCK secX, secY, zPostTop - zPost0 DEL 1 ENDIF ENDIF NEXT i
! handrail IF bRail THEN IF matRail > 0 THEN MATERIAL matRail ELSE MATERIAL SYMB_MAT ENDIF IF iRailProf = 0 THEN ADD -railOvhS, yc, H - railW / 2 ROTy 90 CYLIND A + railOvhS + railOvhE, railW / 2 DEL 2 ELSE ADD -railOvhS, yc - railW / 2, zRailBot BLOCK A + railOvhS + railOvhE, railW, railH DEL 1 ENDIF ENDIF
! infill IF matInfill > 0 THEN MATERIAL matInfill ELSE MATERIAL SYMB_MAT ENDIF IF iInfill = 1 THEN FOR i = 1 TO nB IF iBarProf = 0 THEN ADD px[1], yc, bz[i] ROTy 90 CYLIND px[nBays + 1] - px[1], barD / 2 DEL 2 ELSE ADD px[1], yc - barT / 2, bz[i] - barD / 2 BLOCK px[nBays + 1] - px[1], barT, barD DEL 1 ENDIF NEXT i ENDIF IF iInfill = 2 THEN zb0 = botGap IF bBotRail THEN ADD px[1], yc - botRW / 2, botGap BLOCK px[nBays + 1] - px[1], botRW, botRH DEL 1 zb0 = botGap + botRH ENDIF FOR j = 1 TO nBays fa = px[j] + secX / 2 lc = px[j + 1] - px[j] - secX IF lc > EPS THEN ks = CEIL(lc / MAX(balSp, 0.01) - EPS) FOR m = 1 TO ks - 1 xb = fa + m * lc / ks IF iBalProf = 0 THEN ADD xb, yc, zb0 CYLIND zRailBot - zb0, balD / 2 DEL 1 ELSE ADD xb - balD / 2, yc - balD / 2, zb0 BLOCK balD, balD, zRailBot - zb0 DEL 1 ENDIF NEXT m ENDIF NEXT j ENDIF IF iInfill = 3 OR iInfill = 4 THEN IF iInfill = 3 THEN t = glassT ELSE t = panT ENDIF FOR j = 1 TO nBays xa = px[j] + secX / 2 + infGap xe = px[j + 1] - secX / 2 - infGap IF xe - xa > EPS AND zInf1 - zInf0 > EPS THEN ADD xa, yc + infOffs - t / 2, zInf0 BLOCK xe - xa, t, zInf1 - zInf0 DEL 1 ENDIF NEXT j ENDIF
Symbol.Script_PR: VALUES{2} "iPostProf" 0, "rectangle", 1, "round", 2, "flat bar" VALUES{2} "iPostMode" 0, "by count", 1, "by maximum spacing" VALUES{2} "iMount" 0, "on the slab", 1, "side mounted" VALUES{2} "iRailProf" 0, "round", 1, "rectangle", 2, "flat bar" VALUES{2} "iInfill" 0, "none", 1, "horizontal_bars", 2, "vertical_balusters", 3, "glass", 4, "panel" VALUES{2} "iBarDist" 0, "uniform", 1, "list" VALUES{2} "iBarProf" 0, "round", 1, "rectangle" VALUES{2} "iBalProf" 0, "round", 1, "square" VALUES{2} "iPanType" 0, "solid", 1, "perforated" VALUES "nPost" RANGE [2, 501] VALUES "nBars" RANGE [1, 100] VALUES "postW" RANGE (0, ] VALUES "postD" RANGE (0, ] VALUES "postSp" RANGE [0.01, ] VALUES "railW" RANGE (0, ] VALUES "railH" RANGE (0, ] VALUES "barD" RANGE (0, ] VALUES "balSp" RANGE [0.01, ] VALUES "balD" RANGE (0, ] VALUES "glassT" RANGE (0, ] VALUES "panT" RANGE (0, ]
